_comment: Golden image manifest for the Beacon Relay edge appliance. This describes the reference hardware+software combination that every shipped unit must match or exceed. It is used by validate_golden_manifest.js to check a built image artifact.

reference_hardware.tpm: TPM 2.0 (discrete or fTPM) with SHA-256 PCR bank
reference_hardware.network: 2x Ethernet minimum; optional USB/PCIe LTE modem for failover

software.agent_runtime: Node.js (image pins a version; host/control-plane may run newer during dev)

artifact_requirements.disk_image: raw .img with partition table matching layout above

boot_tests: First-boot provisioning generates device keypair and enrolls in quarantine
LUKS /data opens with TPM-sealed key or software fallback
Agent heartbeat reaches control plane after operator confirm
